title: 第4章 炼出第一缕灵气

content_zh:
“没事不要打扰我！”
方行眼睛有些红，狠狠下了命令，一抹嘴便钻进了木屋里去了。小雀斑与吊死鬼两个，被他吓的不轻，对视了一眼，都感觉方行是疯了，那可是房中宝啊，便是成年壮汉，一次也只能吃一小片叶子，这就足以奋战一整夜了，你这个十岁的小娃，一下子吃了三株……
这特么是要日天么？
方行来到了木屋之中，立刻便按着青云锻气篇上所说的，盘膝而坐，五心朝天。
化精草起作用很迅速，没过多久，方行便感觉一道暴躁的热气从小腹升腾了上来，裤裆里立刻感觉鼓胀胀的。方行深吸了口气，开始按照青云锻气篇上所说的口诀，运转玄法，搬运气血，此时的运转玄法，只是一种心思上的空灵，因为他体内并无灵气可供运转。
药效很猛烈，方行眼睛里甚至都布满了血丝，嘴唇焦枯的厉害。
暴躁的热气在他体内横冲直撞，让他感觉身体鼓胀胀的甚是难受。
“一定可以……”
方行难忍着身体的不适，维系心灵间的空灵之态，不着一迹，不用一力。
渐渐的，一柱香时间过去了，半个时辰过去了。
就连细嫩的面皮也开始胀的红里发紫时，方行体内，忽然出现了一丝异状。
在他不停的以心神在脑海中构想有一道气流随着自己心意运转的时候，体内那已经近乎狂暴的热力，忽然间有一缕分享了出来，化作了一道清凉适人的涓涓细流，若有若无，随着自己的心神运转了起来，与此同时，方行体内的狂暴热力有所减缓，经脉却无比的疼痛。
“成了……”
方行心间大喜，但立刻又谨守心神，强忍着经脉的剧痛，小心翼翼的维系着那丝气息。
本就是一个小小的冒险，没想到真的成功了，方行心间自然无比的兴奋。
他是在看到了化精草时，无意中想到了阴阳神魔鉴上显露出来的青云锻气篇的一个说明：此诀纳天地灵气以修自身，囤于资质，适者寥寥，可以炼精化气，弥补不足。
结合这本书的鉴订之语，再加上这几天方行研读青云锻气篇所得到的感悟，方行已经明白了一件事，修行第一步，就是吐纳调息，修炼自身的灵气。
只是这一步，并不是天下间谁都能做到，有的人的体质亲近天地灵气，修炼起来自然事半功倍，可有的人，比如自己，甚至也包括王志等几个道童，则是道家所说的凡胎，根本难以感悟到灵气的存在。
像王志已经修行了七年，还没有感悟到灵气的存在，这并不罕见，事实上大部分人别说修炼七年，就算修炼一辈子，也感悟不到灵气存在的多的是。
但是吐纳调息，就是唯一凝聚灵气的法门么？

显然也不尽然，即便是肉身凡胎，也是有希望踏入修行之路的，那就是炼精化气。
精乃人身本源之气，这不难理解，想想自己是怎么来的就是了。
而炼精化气，则是将自身的精气，化作修行上的灵气，来破开这第一步的关隘。
方行便是想到了这一点，才看到了一抹曙光，不过，普通人根本感受不到自己精气的存在，这也需要常年累月的感悟去体会，可方行却不同，他本身就是个胆大的，头脑远比别人更灵活，在看到了化精草的时候，他就想到了一个方法，而且只考虑了两息便决定去做了。
既然平时感觉不到，那就让精气旺盛起来！
三株化精草下肚，方行切切实实的感悟到了这旺盛的精气。
那暴烈的热力，便是精气的最直接体现，也就在这时，方行以青云锻气篇里凝聚灵气的法门去搬运那暴烈精气，果然从里面提取出了一丝微弱的灵气出来。
虽然不多，几乎聊胜于无，但终于是迈出了一大步。
如今说来赘述，但当在方行脑里也只是一个一闪即过的念头，便立刻被他实施了。
方行自己都不知道，自己经历了多少凶险。
用这种方法来凝聚灵气，其实是行险之法，等若玩火，稍有不慎，便会欲火焚身，理智尽丧，在这修行上便叫作：走火入魔。
好在，方行年纪虽小，但定力惊人，对别人狠，对自己也狠，硬生生坚持了下来。
“咕……”
在这丝灵气稳固下来，散溢进了自己的经脉之中，暴躁的热力也渐渐去了。

content_en:
"Don't disturb me if it's okay!"
Fang Xing's eyes were a little red, he gave the order sternly, and got into the wooden house with a swipe of his mouth. Little Freckles and Hanged Man were so frightened by him that they looked at each other and felt that Fang Xing was crazy. That was a treasure in the house. Even a grown man could only eat a small leaf at a time, which was enough to fight all night. You, a ten-year-old kid, ate three leaves at once...
Is this really going to happen every day?
Fang Xing came to the wooden house and immediately followed what was said in Qingyun Qi Forging Chapter, sitting cross-legged with his five hearts facing the sky.
The Essence Grass worked very quickly, and not long after, Fang Xing felt an irritable heat rising from his lower abdomen, and his crotch immediately felt bulging. Fang Xing took a deep breath and began to follow the formulas mentioned in Qingyun Qi Forging Chapter to circulate the mysterious method and transport qi and blood. At this time, the mysterious method of operation was just a kind of mental emptiness, because there was no spiritual energy in his body for operation.
The effect of the medicine was so strong that Fang Xing's eyes were even covered with bloodshot eyes and his lips were extremely withered.
The violent heat rushed through his body, making him feel uncomfortable as his body swelled.
"It must be possible..."
Fang Xing couldn't bear the discomfort in his body and maintained the ethereal state in his mind without any trace or effort.
Gradually, the time for a stick of incense passed, and half an hour passed.
When even the delicate skin began to swell and turn red and purple, something strange suddenly appeared inside Fang Xing's body.
When he kept imagining a flow of air in his mind that was moving with his mind, a ray of the almost violent heat in his body suddenly came out and turned into a cool and pleasant trickle. If it was there or not, it started to move with his mind. At the same time, the violent heat in Fang Xing's body slowed down, but his meridians were extremely painful.
"It's done..."
Fang Xing was overjoyed, but immediately guarded his mind, endured the severe pain in his meridians, and carefully maintained the breath.
It was originally a small adventure, but he didn't expect it to be successful. Fang Xing was naturally extremely excited.
When he saw the essence-transforming grass, he accidentally thought of an explanation from the Qingyun Qi Forging Chapter revealed in the Yin-Yang God and Demon Book: This technique absorbs the spiritual energy of the world to cultivate oneself, and hoards the qualifications. The fittest ones are few, and they can refine the Qi to make up for the shortcomings.
Combining the appraisal words of this book and the insights Fang Xing gained from studying Qingyun Qi Forging in the past few days, Fang Xing has understood one thing. The first step in practice is to breathe in and out and cultivate his own spiritual energy.
It's just that not everyone in the world can do this. Some people's physiques are close to the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, so they can practice with twice the result with half the effort. However, some people, such as myself, and even several Taoist boys such as Wang Zhi, are what Taoists call mortal bodies, and it is difficult to realize the existence of spiritual energy at all.
For example, Wang Zhi has been practicing for seven years and has not yet realized the existence of spiritual energy. This is not uncommon. In fact, most people, let alone practicing for seven years, will not realize the existence of spiritual energy even if they practice for a lifetime.
But is breathing and breathing the only way to condense spiritual energy?
Obviously, this is not always the case. Even if you are a mortal, there is still hope of embarking on the path of cultivation, which is to refine your essence and transform your energy.
Essence is the original energy of the human body. This is not difficult to understand. Just think about how you came to be.
Refining Qi is to turn one's own essence into spiritual Qi for cultivation to break through this first step.
It was when Fang Xing thought of this that he saw a glimmer of light. However, ordinary people could not feel the existence of their own essence at all. This also required years of experience to understand, but Fang Xing was different. He was a bold person, and his mind was far more flexible than others. When he saw the essence-transforming grass, he thought of a method, and he decided to do it after only thinking about it for two breaths.
Since you can’t feel it at ordinary times, let’s make your energy strong!After taking the three essence-transforming grasses, Fang Xing truly felt the strong essence.
The violent heat was the most direct manifestation of the essence. At this moment, Fang Xing used the method of condensing spiritual energy in the Qingyun Forging Qi chapter to transport the violent essence, and as expected, a faint trace of spiritual energy was extracted from it.
It's not much, almost better than nothing, but it's finally a big step.
It’s too late to go into details now, but when it was just a fleeting thought in Fang Xing’s mind, he immediately implemented it.
Fang Xing himself didn't know how many dangers he had experienced.
Using this method to condense spiritual energy is actually a dangerous method. If you are playing with fire, if you are not careful, your body will be burned with desire and your reason will be lost. In this practice, it is called: being possessed by fire.
Fortunately, although Fang Xing was young, he had amazing determination and was ruthless to others as well as himself, so he persevered.
"Gu..."
After this trace of spiritual energy stabilized and spread into his own meridians, the irritable heat gradually disappeared.
